'''2006 World Championship Day 2 mserisman DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[mserisman]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (Day 2); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by mserisman (essentialswccg.com).<ref name="src">[http://www.essentialswccg.com/type_build_addremove.php?type=Deck&mode=view&type_id=1324 Deck: Dark Side Beaches]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080123074657/http://www.essentialswccg.com:80/type_build_addremove.php?mode=view&type=Deck&type_id=1324&sid=dfa3faed169938106cd50d61906f9f84 Internet Archive]</ref>
